regimeSub: SPX +0.3% masks tech carnage as Treasuries rally on flight-to-quality while 4% CPI locks in Oct hike odds.
themes: Sep CPI 4.0% YoY confirmed vs 3.7% est per CNBC Oct 14 → 2Y +3bp to 4.82% as Oct hike repriced; Warsh's Aug 28 'rate increases in play' per Axios now consensus as core PCE stuck at 3.0%
SPX +0.3% to 7744 but Tech selloff triggers Treasury rally per FT Oct 15 → 10Y -2bp to 5.19% on flight-to-quality; VIX drops 41bp to 16.46 as equity vol sellers step in despite AI capex doubts

Samsung -5%, SK Hynix -7% per TradingView as 'peak-out' fears per BigGo Finance Oct 15 hit Korean semis → KOSPI rebounds 3.3% to 5720 on dead cat bounce; BOK Gov Shin's Oct 12 rate warning keeps won at 1345

Retail sales +0.8% MoM per Reuters Oct 15 beats on higher gasoline prices but 'masks weakness' per Real Economy Blog → Brent +1.0% to $105.37 as Saudi supply disruptions persist; gold +0.4% to $4199 on stagflation hedge

headline: Tech rout sparks flight-to-quality Treasury rally while 4% CPI locks in Warsh's Oct hike and Korean semis crater on AI peak-out fears.
